storyCards.headline: The Eagles meet disco
storyCards.fact: Glenn Frey and Don Henley built the song around a minor-key idea, while the recording’s four-on-the-floor pulse nodded toward the disco sound rising around the Eagles in Miami.

storyCards.headline: A breakthrough record
storyCards.fact: Frey later described the title song as a breakthrough for the band: darker, sleeker, and more rhythmically adventurous than their earlier country-rock image.
